description: Implement a feature that preserves the user's scroll position when navigating away from a recipe page and returning via the browser's back button. Currently, returning to a recipe page resets the scroll position to the top, which disrupts the user's reading flow. This feature should maintain the exact scroll position where the user left the page.
functional_requirements: Capture and store the current scroll position when the user navigates away from a recipe page
Restore the saved scroll position when the user returns to the recipe page via browser navigation (back/forward buttons)
Ensure the scroll restoration works consistently across different recipe views and sections
Clear stored scroll positions when navigating to unrelated pages to prevent incorrect restoration
Handle edge cases like page refresh or direct URL access without breaking existing navigation behavior
